name: +1 Speed School Escape
desc:
📚 Welcome To +1 Speed School Escape !

❓ HOW TO PLAY: ❓
📚 You're stuck in the world's craziest school, can you escape?
🏃‍♂️ Run through chaotic classrooms, dodge flying homework, and run through angry teachers!
💰 Earn cash by reaching checkpoints and escaping each stage!
📊 Upgrade your speed, stamina, and skills to outsmart the school’s traps!

⚡ Get quicker and smarter with each run and master the art of escaping school!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and show who's the #1!
🎮 Can you ESCAPE all levels of school madness?

👍 Like & Favorite the game to support more school escapes!
🔔 Join our group for exclusive rewards and game news!
